candidates.title: Building py-kvcache: A Performance Characterization of External KV Caching for vLLM with NVMe SSDs
candidates.reason: New September work characterizing GPU/CPU/NVMe KV-cache tradeoffs and implementing asynchronous direct-I/O, bounded staging, scheduler-aware preloading in a vLLM connector.

candidates.title: KVDrive: A Holistic Multi-Tier KV Cache Management System for Long-Context LLM Inference
candidates.reason: GPU/DRAM/SSD multi-tier KV system jointly orchestrates placement, pipelining and cross-tier transfer; directly relevant to storage-backed inference.

candidates.title: ObjectCache: Layerwise Object-Storage Retrieval for KV Cache Reuse
candidates.reason: S3-compatible object-storage KV reuse with layerwise transfer scheduling and NIXL/Ceph/DAOS prototype; useful remote-storage tier design.
